scheme_name: Ex-gratia for Death for the Construction Workers
state: U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must be a nominee or dependent of a deceased registered member of the Board.
The deceased member must have died either during the course of employment or due to any other reason.
benefits_summary: ₹4,00,000 for death during employment and ₹2,00,000 for death due to any other reason.
